IT Help Desk Technician (Tier 1/2)
Desertline Credit Union · Phoenix, AZ

Responsibilities
• Respond to tickets, calls and walk-ups from 400 employees
• Image, deploy and troubleshoot Windows laptops
• Manage user accounts in Active Directory and Microsoft 365
• Escalate complex issues to the infrastructure team

Requirements
• 1+ year of help desk or desktop support experience
• Solid knowledge of Windows 10/11
• Experience with Active Directory and Microsoft 365 administration
• Strong troubleshooting skills
• Excellent customer service and phone etiquette
• A college degree is not required

Preferred
• CompTIA A+ certification
• ITIL Foundation
• Experience supporting macOS

Benefits: health, dental, 401(k) with 6% match, 3 weeks PTO, certification reimbursement, paid overtime.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
